sections.heading: Fracture edges (simple)Rollout
sections.content:
The Fracture edges (simple) rollout contains parameters for the “fracture edges (simple)” fracture mode.

“Fracture edges (simple)” computes a convex hull of the input mesh and then places fracture planes on qualifying edges of that hull. Unlike “Fracture edges (advanced)”, it will not fracture any edges in concave areas of the input mesh.

Fracture edges: when enabled, mesh edges will be fractured.

sections.heading: Edge settings
sections.content:
Edge fractures are generated along edges of the input mesh’s convex hull, that meet the angle threshold criteria.

Angle thresh: the minimum angle that must exist between the faces of an edge on the mesh’s convex hull in order for a fracture mesh to be assigned to the edge.Probability %: the random probability that a given edge (which meets the angle threshold) will be assigned a fracture mesh.Depth: fracture meshes will be placed at this depth along the negative surface normal of each qualified edge. Larger values will move fracture meshes inward towards the center of the mesh hull.Variation %: the per-particle percentage of variation to apply.

Probability %: the random probability that a given edge (which meets the angle threshold) will be assigned a fracture mesh.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content:
Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.

Fracture corners: when enabled, mesh corners will be fractured.

sections.heading: Corner settings
sections.content:

Angle thresh: the minimum angle that must exist between the faces of a vertex on the mesh’s convex hull in order for a fracture mesh to be assigned to the edge.

Probability %: the random probability that a given vertex (which meets the angle threshold) will be assigned a fracture mesh.

sections.heading: Uniqueness
sections.content:
Seed: the seed value for all varied parameters.

Cull fractured meshes: when enabled, fractured parts of the input mesh that lie above the fracture meshes will be culled. Disable this setting to retain all fracture meshes after the fracture operation is completed.
